nodes.notes: Searches for HR contacts at the company

nodes.notes: Combines organization and people data

nodes.notes: Only proceed if we found an HR contact

nodes.name: Apollo Contact Match
nodes.notes: Gets verified email and phone for HR contact

nodes.name: Finalize Contact Data
nodes.notes: Finalizes contact data with verified email

nodes.notes: Only proceed if we have an email address

nodes.notes: Checks if lead already exists in Google Sheets

nodes.name: Check Duplicate
nodes.notes: Checks if lead was contacted in last 30 days

nodes.name: IF Should Contact
nodes.notes: Proceeds only if not contacted in last 30 days

nodes.name: Clean Data
nodes.notes: Cleans company names and job titles

nodes.name: Google Sheets Append
nodes.notes: Adds new leads to Google Sheets

nodes.name: Limit 50
nodes.notes: Limits to 50 leads per day

nodes.name: Build Approval Email
nodes.notes: Builds the approval request email

nodes.name: Gmail Approval Request
nodes.notes: Sends approval request to Flavio

nodes.name: Gmail Trigger Reply
nodes.notes: Triggers on Flavio's reply

nodes.name: Parse Reply
nodes.notes: Parses Flavio's approval/skip decisions

nodes.name: Filter Approved
nodes.notes: Filters to only approved leads

nodes.name: IF Has Approved
nodes.notes: Checks if there are approved leads

nodes.name: Spam Check
nodes.notes: Checks business hours and adds random delay

nodes.name: IF Can Send
nodes.notes: Proceeds only if within business hours

nodes.name: Wait Random Delay
nodes.notes: Waits 5-15 minutes between emails

nodes.name: Personalize Email
nodes.notes: Creates personalized email with random references

nodes.name: Gmail Send Outreach
nodes.notes: Sends personalized outreach email

nodes.name: Google Sheets Update Sent
nodes.notes: Updates lead status to 'Gesendet'
